api_execution_measurements.meaning: Original source-qualified provider-reported search seconds, once per newly received logical provider job after the inherited baseline. Physical attempts, retry history, queue wait and turnaround are unknown.

api_failure.meaning: The latest actual selected provider failure; no fresh operation at closure.

api_reported_execution_forecasts.meaning: Frozen provider-reported search-duration forecasts for the exact exposed technical configuration and original current condition. Remote revision, allocation, corpus release and corpus sizes are unknown. Support counts logical provider-job reported results; internal physical attempts, retries and reliability are unknown. The named provider interval is not queue wait, HTTP time or job turnaround. Historical minimum/maximum are not calibrated prediction intervals. No action, credit or waiting rule is derived.

api_result_coverage.meaning: Saved assigned-page acquisition and projection coverage, not scientific completion.

changed_annotation_refs.meaning: Actual changed annotation revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_assessment_refs.meaning: Actual changed assessment revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_interpretation_account_refs.meaning: Actual changed episode-owned coherent interpretation accounts; these are not parent annotation revisions.

changed_record_refs.meaning: New or revised semantic records explicitly identified as changed by recorded work.

committed_record_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by completed own work and completed child investigations.

credit.meaning: Projected credit at child completion for its fixed assigned scope; redelivery preserves that snapshot.

episode_yield.meaning: Recorded closing local numerical forecast and continuation decision, in the child's configured controller units. It is not task credit, a job ETA, a parent instruction or goal completion. Null when the controller does not expose the supported typed numerical state. Normal status is 0; -1 means insufficient observations and -2 means unidentifiable, not negative predicted gain.

completed_actions.description: Completed own actions at this child's level; an investigation commissioned by it counts once.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

execution_handoff.meaning: The latest original usable received or own selected check when exactly one physical execution is known; null for zero or several identities. No new receiving check occurs at closure.

execution_handoffs.meaning: For each distinct registry and execution handle, the available usable check with latest original checked_at, in identity order. This records available facts without selecting a resource or rechecking it.

interpretation_basis_refs.meaning: Semantic references visible to the last admitted report interpretation response and available at this report boundary, including source-window custody and admitted typed forms. A visible handle does not establish that its full record or source body was read.

job_checked_status.meaning: The status and timestamp of this child's last successful selected homology.check_handoff action. This is the recorded check-time state, not a fresh closure poll or a monitoring sample. Null if no selected check succeeded. The parent decides what subsequent work this information warrants.

job_cpu.meaning: Assigned CPU threads selected by the parent and retained in the job; not measured consumption.

job_handoff.meaning: The original recorded usable receiving handoff available to this episode; no new receiving check occurs at closure.

job_handoff_failure.meaning: The basic reason no usable handoff could be returned; null after a successful receiving-interface check.

job_handoff_state.meaning: Whether an original usable checked handoff is available in the assigned or received records; no scientific completion claim.

job_ref.meaning: The immutable assigned job, not an episode identity.

job_sample.meaning: The last actual sample selected by this child, unchanged on replay; null if it selected none.

last_outcome_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by the last completed own ordinary action.

monitoring_information_credit.meaning: One caller-bound monitoring-information unit per new typed received duration identity in the union of native physical phase attempts and logical provider-job reported results, after the original inherited baseline. Repeated delivery earns none. Scientific and operational controller scalars retain their original meanings.

native_execution_measurements.meaning: Newly received completed native durations relative to the frozen inherited/original knowledge. Unmeasured outcomes remain in their original receipts/results and earn no completed-duration credit. Execution outcomes and durations do not establish biological findings. Unknown CPU remains null.

observations_after_report_basis.meaning: Last ordinary-action observations not supplied to that interpretation response.

pending_handles.meaning: Original selected child executions still pending when this episode closed. These handles survive parent closure; closure does not cancel them or establish scientific completion.

resource_tool_estimates.meaning: Frozen resource/tool execution forecasts from recorded statistics and selected samples. Expected total duration is conditional on successful completion of the exact class under the current recorded condition. Outcome support describes that same condition; null support means unknown, and zero counts mean observed empty history. Observed minimum/maximum are historical ranges, not calibrated prediction intervals. Local service wall time does not separately measure queue wait or program runtime. CPU is the configured allocation; memory/scratch fields are limits, not measured consumption. No credit, action choice, remaining duration or stop/schedule decision is derived here.

subject_refs.meaning: Original input subjects assigned by the parent.

goal.objective: Prepare and check assigned API execution

task_context.root_objective:
Fixture runtime inspection; no biological inference.
Investigate only the fixed original gene input_5072df31a89885282599fa44. Read the caller evidence inventory source source_96f2013de8ee913d0786d9f3 for already acquired sources and native measurements. Those are prior inputs, not new episode contributions or established target-function conclusions. Existing unchanged work is reusable; do not repeat acquisition or native searches merely to exercise tools. Reason from actual source methods, subjects and conditions; retain competing explanations and justified uncertainty. Choose useful iterative child investigations, ordinary tools and reasoning from outcomes. No child sequence, number of iterations or scientific completion is prescribed by this harness.

report_lifecycle: Interpretations are the last actual reasoning basis; later tool outcomes are facts, not a new judgment.
requested_report_purpose: Return the checked original API receiving interfaces

scientific_child_credit_binding.meaning: Local scientific investigation credit; not an additive parent task score.
